title: DeviceRecord
description: Deserialization of `DeviceRecord` requires `schema_version` and `schema_id`. Legacy NDJSON produced by rastreo v0.5 or earlier will fail to deserialize; consumers should tag legacy records with an explicit v0 marker before ingest.

alt_ips.description: Additional IPs merged into this device by the identity fuser — empty when no identity fuser is configured or when the fuser saw nothing to merge. Each entry carries a role hint and the probe kinds that responded on that IP.

confidence.description: Confidence score in `[0.0, 1.0]` computed as `baseline + signals_observed * per_signal`, clamped. Higher values indicate stronger evidence that the record reflects a real device.

identity_key.description: Canonical device identifier: `mac:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX` when a MAC is discovered, else `ip:<address>`. Consumers use this as the primary identity key across scans.

last_seen.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the most recent probe that produced signals for this device.

mac.description: First MAC address emitted across all probers against this device. Formatted as lower-case colon-separated hex.

manufacturer.description: Vendor name resolved from the MAC OUI prefix by the OUI enrichment fuser. `null` when the OUI is not in the bundled Wireshark manuf database.

mgmt_ip.description: Management IP the device was probed on. For multi-IP devices merged by the identity fuser, this is the first target IP that survived resolution.

platform.description: Fielded platform identifier (e.g. `cisco_ios`, `linux`, `junos`) derived from SNMP `sysDescr` or SSH banner parsing. Currently always `null`; populated once platform classification lands.

possible_alias_of.description: When set, this record is a medium-confidence alias of another record identified by the given `IdentityKey`.

role.description: Fielded device role (e.g. `router`, `switch`, `host`) derived from `sysObjectID` prefix or port-based heuristics. Currently always `null`; populated once role classification lands.

scan_metadata.description: Provenance stamped by the pipeline at scan entry.

schema_id.description: Canonical schema URL; always `CURRENT_SCHEMA_ID` for records emitted by this build.

schema_version.description: Schema version tag; always `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION` for records emitted by this build.

signals.description: Deduplicated list of every observable fact collected from every prober that targeted this device.

AltIp.description: Additional IP merged into a `DeviceRecord` by the identity fuser, carrying the role hint and the probe kinds that responded on that IP.

responded_via.description: Probe kinds that responded on this IP before the identity fuser merged it into the primary record.

role.description: Role hint mapped to NetBox / Nautobot / Infrahub IP-address role models. `None` when the identity fuser can't infer a role from available signals.

AltIpRole.description: Role hint attached to each `AltIp`. Values map 1:1 to NetBox / Nautobot / Infrahub IP-address role models so downstream reconcilers pull the role directly instead of re-inferring it.

oneOf.description: Secondary interface address on the same device.
Loopback address. Not currently inferred; reserved for future SNMP `ifDescr` signal.
VRRP virtual IP — detected from the `00:00:5e:00:01:XX` or `00:00:5e:00:02:XX` MAC prefix.
HSRP virtual IP — detected from the `00:00:0c:07:ac:XX` MAC prefix.
CARP virtual IP. Not currently inferred from MAC because CARP shares the VRRPv2 prefix; reserved for future signal-based detection.
Anycast address. Not currently inferred; reserved.
Virtual IP (VIP) fronting real IPs. Not currently inferred; reserved.

ScanMetadata.description: Per-scan provenance stamped on every emitted `DeviceRecord`. `scan_id` is a ULID; consumers can sort and correlate records by it.
